text: Artificial intelligence is changing the modern workplace in many ways. One major change is automation, where machines handle repetitive tasks that people used to do. This allows workers to focus on more creative and complex problems. Companies also use AI-powered productivity tools to organize schedules and manage data faster. Instead of replacing humans completely, many businesses now encourage human-AI collaboration. For example, AI can suggest ideas, and people make the final decisions. However, these changes also mean some jobs may disappear while new ones appear. Workers need to learn new skills to stay competitive. Overall, AI offers both opportunities and challenges for everyone.
